about_the_game:
Spar Kart is a free-to-play racing fighting game that seamlessly combines the excitement of kart racing with the strategic depth of competitive fighting game mechanics. Created by experienced professionals in the fighting game community, Spar Kart delivers a unique gaming experience that bridges the gap between casual accessibility and competitive depth.

Our vision is to create a game that welcomes newcomers with intuitive gameplay while providing the mechanical complexity that competitive players crave. Whether you're looking for casual fun with friends or intense competitive matches, Spar Kart is designed to deliver on both fronts.

Features

Spar Kart is built with competitive players in mind, featuring advanced systems designed to support both casual fun and serious competition.

Rollback Net Code

Experience smooth, responsive online play with rollback net code (client side prediction with reconciliation) using FishNet Networking. Fight players from around the world with minimal input delay and maximum responsiveness.

Dedicated Game Servers

Stable, reliable connections powered by dedicated game servers ensure consistent gameplay for all players, regardless of location.

Online Training Room

Practice with friends online or offline in our comprehensive training mode. Set up specific scenarios, practice combos, and learn character matchups in a controlled environment.

Ranked Matchmaking

Climb the ranks, practice your skills, and prove your worth in competitive matches that matter.

Custom Lobbies

Create your own private lobbies with custom rules, settings, and match parameters. Perfect for tournaments, practice sessions, or playing with friends with your preferred game settings.

Community Hub

View online leaderboards, join community events, and follow your favorite creators in our community hub.

Unique Character Combat

Every character in Spar Kart is designed with a distinct fighting style and personality, offering players multiple ways to approach combat and racing. Each character comes equipped with a complete arsenal of attacks and abilities:

4 Unique Attacks

Every character has four distinct attack moves that can be used to damage opponents, knock them off the track, or create strategic advantages. These attacks are consistent, reliable, and designed to work in harmony with each character's fighting style.

4 Unique Special Abilities

In addition to basic attacks, each character possesses four special abilities that can turn the tide of battle. These abilities range from defensive maneuvers to devastating offensive techniques, each carefully balanced to maintain competitive integrity.
